instruction: My roommate requested me to pay for my share of the housing bill this month on venmo today. But they forgot about the 15% rent increase starting this month. So reject that payment request and send them the corrected amount of money with a note, "Correcting for 15% rent increase.".
notes: The roommate is identified through phone.search_contacts with relationship 'roommate' (gives their email). The housing payment request is located among received Venmo requests (pending, created today, from the roommate); its id and amount become known via the lookup action. The request is then denied (only denied_at changes) and a new transaction is sent to the roommate's email for 1.15x the requested amount with the exact note. The corrected amount is a runtime-computed object linked to the request by the static (corrected-amount) fact. supervisor.complete_task takes no answer (not a question) and is forced last via (not (task-completed)) on every other action; its non-API parameters are task records only.
